Post‑task questionnaires (NASA‑TLX) and additional surveys assessing fluency, reliability, UI dependency, decision consistency, and perceived speed.

Participants are asked to complete specified tasks within an application through three methods: manually, with the assistance of a UI Agent, and with the assistance of AXIS. Post-task questionnaires include NASA-TLX metrics and learning effort, agent fluency/reliability, UI dependency, decision consistency, and perceived completion speed.
